phone.notes: The app waits up to 3 seconds for the answer of the bracelet (before, about 0.6 s), which should help the reads that ended in "Tag was lost". If it still fails, tell us your phone model in #bug-reports. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: The adventure screens look like the other menus of the watch, and a lost fight no longer takes vitals. If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in #bug-reports.
